cross_dataset_overlap.finding: No exact cross-dataset resume or job matches detected across primary corpora. Datasets represent distinct upstream collections.

leakage_risks_identified: In Dataset 2 (Shresth786), 1,167 jobs are matched against 9,544 CVs resulting in 122,560 pairs (averaging ~105 pairs per job). A naive random train/val/test split will leak identical job postings across splits, causing artificially inflated accuracy.
In Dataset 3 (harsh72877287), multiple rows share identical job skill requirements with varying candidate scores.

In Dataset 4 (vadimas22), GPT-4o was used to score and evaluate candidate-job fit. If GPT-4o is also used as an automated evaluation judge, this creates an automated self-preference circular evaluation loop.

recommended_splitting_strategy.details: Candidates and Jobs must be partitioned into disjoint subsets (e.g. Candidate-Disjoint Split or Job-Disjoint Split). No candidate_id and no job_id present in the training partition should ever appear in the validation or test partitions.
